recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-44721 unless OO later chooses a new scoped vital-sign component unit mechanism.
issue_request: FHIR-44721 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO request to remove the overly narrow required binding on Observation.component.valueQuantity in the Vital Signs profile by changing it to http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly named FHIR-44721, but Jira comments state that the FHIR-47136 application, especially git fb9f069 on 2025-03-16, already made the http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs binding change and satisfied FHIR-44721.
additional_context: The linked Zulip discussion describes validation failures for oxygen saturation flowrate components using UCUM units outside the old small vital-signs unit set, and 2024-02-23 OO minutes record the motion to bind to http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs instead of the constrained required list.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current base vital signs StructureDefinition already declares Observation.component.value[x]:valueQuantity with binding strength preferred and valueSet http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs.
